Creates a new button node with centered text label.Applies current button state colors to background and label.Sets button state and refreshes visuals when state changed.Enables or disables the button.Returns true when button is not disabled.Transitions button to hover state when enabled.Transitions button to normal state when enabled.Transitions button to active state when enabled.Handles mouse release and fires onClick when appropriate.Replaces button label text.Hit tests a screen-space point against button bounds.

Button = ref object of Node

ButtonColors = object

  activeBg*: Color
  disabledBg*: Color
  normalText*: Color
  hoverText*: Color
  activeText*: Color
  disabledText*: Color
ButtonState = enum
